reviews.text: They never have what I need for my cat. I stop by every month and I always see the same signs or hear from the employees that they’re waiting on their supply trucks. But it’s been the 4th time a row that they don’t carry much for cats. I’d like to support small businesses but then I end up just buying at HEB across the street because of reasons like this.

Was denied the full amount of crickets by a rude lady at the front desk because it wouldn't leave any crickets for other customers, yet after the attitude she barely could even get the amount she told me I could get. So If you dont have enough then dont say you can have a certain amount of crickets and charge me before counting them out. Then I was told to come back in a week but the amount sold wont last a week and no other options were given, no other stores or food recommendations.  I have proudly gone to this store for 5 years, and I refuse to go back again. I have never been told they cant sell me the amount of crickets I need just to leave for other customers, I have been told they dont have the full amount or what is left is needed for the pets in store, which is reasonable.

Poor customer service, they are rude and treat there customers poorly. They don't accommodate large dogs in their wash tub area- more for smaller dogs due to time constraints. This is not how to run a business. I won't be back.

A heads up for anyone wanting to use the dog wash station— they close it one hour before the store closes. But make sure to get there before that too because they start the disinfecting process before the dog washing station officially closes bc I guess they can’t disinfect it in the hour between the station closing and the store closing lol
They have crickets !

Friendly knowledgeable staff, prices are a bit more than the big box stores but I feel good supporting small business.

And they usually have crickets in stock when Petco and Petsmart are out!
Many things seemed out of stock but I still got what I needed!!

Every time I came, 5 stars! Always awesome doing business with this place. They made it worth the drive with my pups. I drive 45-60 minutes to come here for their bath stations for my pups. It's convenient especially having 3 pups. Since I broke my leg, me, my dad, and my brother have frequent here to give them their baths. Now that I have recovered, I still go for their kindness and respectfulness.

Usually when I come, the gentleman is super nice and helpful, even gave a free wash one time. However my recent visit was just disrespectful, the gentleman wasn't there.

I walked in, the lady at the register was helpful and advised there was a wait. I understood. Once the wash was open I got ready with my puppy and immediately was stopped by another lady employee with glasses yelled, not asked, not talked, yelled at me to take my pup out. I was respectful but her tone and actions were heavily disrespectful. After waiting for them to spray the water hose on the bath to "clean," they made me wait 30 minutes. Usually I go wash and I never waited when a pup was done. However when the other bath was open, they let my brother wash my pup right away with no issue, they didn't make him wait to "clean" the bath. I do apologize if I did something wrong but I personally felt targeted and attacked. The gentleman I usually see if humble and nice, instead I was met with a lady who rudely profiled me. The other lady was nice, and was trying to help but seems they both need some customer service training. I do have washes left but I'm uncomfortable to go back. I'm afraid if I walk in I will be profiled again and disrespected. Thank you.

I went to this store was told about the mcp mobile clinic that comes to their store on Saturday  so I went this past Saturday  I asked for a receipt to have I was not not given one in person or via email  so I called to pet plus store who allows them in their store and they said they could not help me that situation. Very sad since they allow them to use they store for their business.
Appreciate that they have Open Farm kibble for my dog. Friendly and helpful staff. Became a member upon my first visit.

I gave this store 5 stars maybe few months ago and I take it back. I deleted it and today, I got the worst customer service and very rude employees. I am a supporter of the store  for months.  But today just had me turn it around and say I won’t come back here for a while till they refix customer services and the employees.
I went in today to grab some food for my dogs as usually because I loved the store I like to purchase a few items. I came in no greeting just laughing employees looking at me as i came in. I usually look at sales before I get my regular food for my dogs. I was in there for about 10 mins or so. Just employees laughing on the ladder  while I  look around. About 8 mins in I decided I’m ready to pay.  The lady went up to the  register and automatically gave me a DEATH RUDE stare like she hated me!!!  and just automatically scanned. No smile no nothing just rude stare. I told her I am a rewards member and had a coupon if she can look up my number. Rolled her eyes, rude said oooooooooh ok what’s your number, still rude stare. Gave her my number and didn’t say anything to me but my total. After I purchased she then gives receipt and said thanks I asked can Iget a bag for my items. Oh gawsh she had an attitude for that.i told her I can do it if she doesn’t want too… she then grabs the food and puts it In the bag and rolls eyes rude stare. I usually ask for samples but I didn’t because she is the one that always tells me we can’t give too much samples. Which I know they have a lot, but for her to tell me she can’t give customers samples is rude. Didn’t want ask cause she look like she wasn’t having it with me,Why bother.  I honestly felt so attacked for just purchasing my dogs food.  I feel that the store has become less helpful and more annoyed employees. I didn’t want to come in here to ruin someone.
But I love this store, and for me to take back my 5 star is sad. I hope the OWNER sees this, and rethinks about services to new and old customers. Re-train associates  or get new employees about customer service and management. I will not come in for a while, because I didn’t do anything wrong but buy food for my dogs and for your employees to just not care about what they do in there work Field and attitude. Hopefully you can help them be better.  AER0/ green shirt with glasses female long hair. She just didn’t want me to shop in the store, no greet,  sorry if I was looking at clearance and was about to ask for samples but I didn’t cause you roll eyes as you rang my items. I didn’t ask for samples after a purchase because you gave a B- face I hope services in the store changes and gets better.

A down-to-earth place that offers great value. Staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They helped me choose the right combination of species for my new aquarium, and after 7 days, all are alive and thriving.
Update: I over-aerated my 10-gallon tank, causing the ph level to climb above the acceptable range, and all my fish died. The Pets Plus staff encoraged me to bring in a water sample for testing (free of charge), and they diagnosed the problem and provided a solution. The Pets Plus team genuinely cares about what they do, and are willing to go the extra mile to help people provide the best environment for their pets.
Thank you, Pets Plus! You're my 💯 go-to pet store!
BTW- now that kids are out of school, this is a great place to get out of the heat for a while and look around.  Go meet Tiki the bird 🦜 and see if you can make him dance!

Omg! I was out with my puppy just killing some time and looking for some good things for him to chew on and we popped into this store. The staff was so friendly and absolutely made Ollie feel at home. He is a rescue so we are still working on our people anxiety he made friends quick and they were absolutely amazing to him. We hope to come back soon for some more cool toys and chews! Great selection too though they do seem to be rebuilding and resetting a lot of things. We can't wait to come back!

Buy a dog wash pass for 35$ you get 5 washes you get 1for free they have snacks for your pets they have the tubs set up in the back where you can wash your pet and use their shampoos overall a great place for your pet

So convenient, I recommend getting the wash card if you like washing your dog yourself. The staff is so friendly, the entire store is clean and the wash area is clean ! They include a variety of shampoos and conditioners, blow dryer, towels, treats and also other medical shampoos. 10/10! Pictured below is one of the two tubs I used for my dobie.
Samara & April were great help! Thank you guys for everything!
Samara and Aprils customer service out of this WORLD! They helped me transfer my points from my previous pet forward to theirs as well as helped me autoship my dog food! Thank you!

First time shopping and buying from this store. I will say I enjoyed the help I got from April, she was a delight, friendly and funny. She helped me pick out some good products for my kitties! I will be back soon!

Dallas was absolutely wonderful to work with today. She helped me choose a new dog food for my two Cane Corsos, including one with digestion issues, and really took the time to walk me through the options. She explained the benefits of the brand I was considering in a way that was easy to understand and never made me feel rushed.

What really stood out was how kind and patient she was. She even reassured me that I could bring the food back if my dogs didn’t like it—which gave me peace of mind, especially since one of mine is a total diva and incredibly picky.

Choosing the right food can be stressful, but Dallas made the whole process feel much easier and more manageable. I truly appreciated her help and would absolutely recommend asking for her if you need guidance!

Thank you, Dallas for all your help!

This store is absolutely amazing. Mavis, Gyoza, and Stardust are all absolutely happy with their new home.

Each and every employee that we have ever interacted with has been nothing but polite, kind, and, courteous.

Haley and Aero are always more than willing to go out of their way in assisting customers with whatever they need.

If it's not in stock they can direct you right where to find it or are more than happy to place an order for it.

Hands down the best pet store in San Antonio.

Gyoza is the gecko. Stardust is the African Green Bush Snake..

I post a picture of Mavis as well but Asian Forest scorpions love to hide 😉
